Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to extract the specific price history data (all-time high and all-time low) required by the Orchestrator. Although the Orchestrator explicitly instructed it to "Click the 'Once Upon a Time, Throne of Eldraine (ELD) Price History - MTGGoldfish' link to obtain the all-time high and all-time low prices," the WebSurfer's response only reported the search results page and the visible metadata/OCR text. It did not navigate to the specific price history page, extract the numerical values for the highest and lowest prices, or report them back. This is a failure to execute the specific data extraction task, leading to incomplete information gathering and an inability to calculate the price decrease for the cards.
